name: NFI Distribution Center Perris CA (Indian Ave)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Dec-2025 Street View at the south driveway off Morgan St shows a black sliding/swing metal gate spanning the full truck-lane throat; perimeter fencing wraps the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere beside the lane in any Street View heading; the building wall and fence are the only structures at the entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: A bank of self-service check-in kiosks/pedestals is mounted just inside the gate (visible in the N / NNW / NNE frames), implying app/kiosk driver check-in rather than a guard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite building faces: a long north dock row (with a deep multi-row trailer drop yard) and a separate south dock row.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Deep north yard is filled with multiple long rows of parked trailers (no tractors) = dedicated trailer storage, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide single gate apron with ample unused paved width to stripe an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate from overhead; building is 2,152 ft long with near-continuous dock rows on both N and S faces. ~200 doors total is approximate (band 50+ is firm).
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count across north drop-yard rows, dock-backed trailers, and south apron.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Approximate; comparable nearby NFI Perris (Nance St) was reported at 224 spots, this larger 1.3M-sf site estimated higher.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined in/out driveway; lane split not clearly markable from imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Perris industrial park; open scrubland immediately south and east of the property along Morgan St.

citations.claim: NFI hiring warehouse roles in Perris (3700 Indian Ave) as of May 2026
303,435 sf of the 1,309,754 sf Hanesbrands DC actively for lease (Colliers), multi-tenant

verification.flag: Building carved to multi-tenant; NFI footprint shrank. Dock/yard counts in source record likely overstated. Hanesbrands exiting West Coast distribution = further contraction risk.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE/DOWNGRADE: NFI still hires at 3700 Indian Ave (May 2026) but the building is now multi-tenant - 303,435 sf of 1.3M sf actively for-lease (Colliers) after Hanesbrands 2024 restructuring gave back space. Re-scope to a partial NFI footprint, not a dedicated 1.3M sf DC.
